stories.title: Barnwell pitches 11 pre-deadline NFL trades: Which teams should deal for Barkley, BTJ and Mack?
stories.summary: Saquon Barkley joining a contender? Brian Thomas Jr. headed out west? Khalil Mack and Donte Jackson boosting a defense? Let's build 11 win-win trades.

stories.title: Sources: Eagles RB Barkley expected to practice, in line to play vs. Cowboys
stories.summary: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley is expected to return to practice Thursday and is in line to play Monday against the Cowboys, sources told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo.

stories.title: Warriors rookie Lendeborg says he 'lost all respect' for Luka after testy matchup
stories.summary: Yaxel Lendeborg said it was an "interesting first game for me" after defending the Lakers superstar in his professional debut.

stories.title: Bills DB Gardner-Johnson's suspension for spitting stands after appeal
stories.summary: Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson's one-game suspension for spitting at Raiders players in Sunday's game has been upheld by hearing officer Jordy Nelson.

stories.title: Utah DT Wallace under rape investigation, allegedly sent videos on social media
stories.summary: Utah senior defensive tackle Jamal Wallace is under investigation for the alleged rape of a woman in which he is also accused of sharing videos of the incident on social media.
